episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: On her birthday, Yoon Ji Woo witnesses the horrific death of her father. Hell-bent on taking revenge at any cost, she sets out to find his killer.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Choi Moo Jin imposes punishment on Do Gang Jae. Instructed to join the police force undercover, Ji Woo takes on a brand-new identity.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: When her team goes after an unforeseen target in a sudden raid, Ji Woo must act fast. A new drug ring and its malevolent leader threaten Moo Jin's empire.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Cha Gi Ho sees Gang Jae's declaration of war on Moo Jin as an opportunity. Suspecting Ji Woo is up to something, Jun Pil Do tails her.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Ji Woo and Pil Do's narrow escape from peril shifts the police's focus onto Gang Jae. A run-in with a familiar face at the precinct places Ji Woo on edge.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: A photo in the mail revealing obscured truths casts everything Ji Woo thought she believed into doubt. Moo Jin moves to protect his interests.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: Ji Woo fights off an ambush. Moo Jin submits himself to a police interrogation. Pil Do gets his hands on incriminating phone call records.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: Intent on changing Ji Woo's mind about carrying out her vengeance, Pil Do handcuffs himself to her. Moo Jin reacts to another act of betrayal.
